title: Not just a number: Science is redefining how we understand ageing

fields.headline: Not just a number: Science is redefining how we understand ageing
fields.sourceHeadline: “Not just a number: Science is redefining how we understand ageing”
fields.note: Featuring aging clocks for global policy audience.

excerpt.text: Recently developed “biologically informed” (based on biological pathways) and “causally guided” (anchored in disease prediction) epigenetic biomarkers offer a more nuanced picture that could shape future health interventions and improve individual health outcomes.
